title: LMU core OpenStreetMap extract
timestamp_note: Retrieval time rounded to minute; preserve server osm3s timestamp independently. Server returned 2026-06-01T08:52:28Z; do not present this extract as a live November ground survey.
trim_rule: Keep nodes in bounds and whole ways whose vertex bounding boxes intersect these bounds; keep Universität stop_area relation 1619275. No geometry simplification, no coordinate edits, no synthetic nodes. Relation member geometry is retained as returned and may extend outside the query bbox.
coordinates: WGS84 lat/lon exactly as supplied by Overpass. Derived game geometry is separately recorded in docs/reference/core_world.json.
limitations: Mapped points are not survey-grade; decimal precision does not imply centimetre accuracy.
Square legal/paved boundaries and actual kerb lines were not returned as area/kerb polygons. Derived envelopes are labelled estimates.
Tree species absent in core tree tags; broadleaved only.
Supplementary entrance/area:highway queries timed out or returned 429; use returned stop_area member coordinates for the southern entrances.
A/B/C/D/E/F/M/N are building/room block names, not street address suffixes.
Below-ground railway platforms and paths must not be turned into surface obstacles.
